from the corkboard

Wayology Video Service

06/2026 – present·Svelte · Fastify · LiveKit · TypeScript

Video-consultation service for a wellness platform: pre-call device checks, secure room joining, in-call controls, reconnection states, and call diagnostics for scheduled 1:1 consultant–client sessions.

  • Building the service end-to-end in a TypeScript pnpm monorepo: Svelte video-room frontend, Fastify token/webhook backend, self-hosted LiveKit media stack.
  • Validating call quality with real-device QA (iOS/Android), a Playwright e2e suite gating deployments, staging environments, and WebRTC codec/simulcast tuning.

CLO — Mailing Management Platform

10/2022 – 07/2025·Angular · TypeScript · Tailwind

Enterprise dashboard for automating internal mailing and workspace/project management workflows — nearly three years on a long-lived production codebase.

  • Built and maintained dashboard workflows for workspaces, accounts, contacts, projects and users: reusable table/layout patterns, multi-step forms, modals and API-connected data views with client-side filtering.
  • Developed a customizable statistics dashboard with a widget builder and drag-and-drop layout; migrated the architecture to Angular Standalone Components with OnPush change detection.
  • Improved dense data-table UX with virtual scrolling and accessibility refinements.

SHAAP — Skate Care Membership Platform

11/2025 – 06/2026·Next.js 16 · React 19 · TypeScript · Stripe

Membership and e-commerce platform for a Canadian self-serve skate-sharpening network: marketing site, multi-step registration funnel and Stripe-backed subscriptions. Sole developer of the web platform.

  • Built a 6-step guarded registration funnel (personal info, membership, cabin, blades, review, payment) with draft persistence, react-hook-form + Zod validation and BFF route handlers in a Turborepo monorepo.
  • Implemented a mock-first workflow (OpenAPI-generated API client + MSW scenarios) enabling fully backend-free demos, and hardened the Stripe flow with payment intents, webhooks, idempotency and retry recovery.

About

I've spent 10+ years building frontends hands-on, and now work in AI-assisted development workflows — directing, reviewing and verifying code across the stack. My strongest ground is data-heavy UI — dashboards, complex forms, product surfaces — and making legacy codebases healthier.

The name zenv is zen + env: a calm, well-kept environment is how I like both my code and my desk. The pixel room above is AI-generated art — fitting, for a workflow where AI is a daily tool.

Frontend: TypeScript, React, Angular, Vue/Nuxt, Svelte/SvelteKit, Tailwind
UI engineering: component architecture, data-heavy tables, complex forms, accessibility
State / data: Redux Toolkit, RxJS, REST, WebSockets, WebRTC (LiveKit)
Testing / tooling: Playwright e2e, Vite, Git, Docker, Figma
AI: AI-assisted development workflows
